places.name: Jake and Lorena's camp near San Antonio
places.note: Lorena enjoys the open-air life while a jealous, drunken Jake sulks, gossips about Call and Maggie, and toys with abandoning her in Austin.
places.location_hint: small clearing about a mile from the Hat Creek herd, roughly an hour's ride from San Antonio and two days short of Austin

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Lorena refuses to go in, angering Jake; he rides to town alone at night for whiskey and races back.

places.name: Austin
places.note: Two days ahead; Jake considers slipping away and leaving Lorena there.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Lorena's mare no longer looks back toward it; Jake wishes he had left Lorena there.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Where Jake had dallied with Elmira before she married July.
